stories.headline: Five EU countries plan a Rwanda return hub
stories.summary: Five European countries plan a return hub in Rwanda for rejected asylum seekers. A pilot of about a hundred people could start in twenty twenty-seven, but nothing is signed.
stories.label: Slightly Globalist
stories.why: Nations get tougher on borders, under an EU rule.
stories.what_it_means: Nations get tougher on borders, under a European Union rule.
stories.economic_impact: The five countries pay the costs.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a landlord paying for a room across town.

stories.headline: Jordan and Iraq block Telegram
stories.summary: Jordan and Iraq blocked the Telegram app on the same day, hours apart. Neither went through a court, and Jordan gave no end date.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: Two governments switch off a messaging app, with no court.
stories.what_it_means: Two governments switched off a way millions of people talk, with no court.
stories.economic_impact: Small businesses and news channels lose reach.
stories.everyday_example: It's like cutting every phone line on the block.

stories.headline: US license rule for AI chips and rentals
stories.summary: The U S now requires a license before A I chips go to five countries, including Singapore and Brazil. Anyone who rents that computing to China-based companies also needs one.
stories.label: Slightly Sovereign
stories.why: The United States is protecting its own technology and security.
stories.what_it_means: The United States is protecting its own technology and security.
stories.economic_impact: Data centers there face new delays.
stories.everyday_example: It's like locking your own tools in the shed.

stories.headline: Pax Silica protests and 300 arrests
stories.summary: About three hundred protesters were arrested at the U S led Pax Silica hub in the Philippines as Trump arrived. Indigenous families in Tarlac say the new zone will push them off their land.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: A foreign-led factory zone goes ahead over local land.
stories.what_it_means: A foreign-led factory zone is going ahead over local land.
stories.economic_impact: Families there stand to lose land.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a chain building on the family farm.

stories.headline: Ukraine knocks a Crimean Bridge span into the sea
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces knocked a span of the Crimean Bridge into the sea. Strikes on two days dropped a road arch into the water and damaged the rail.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: A NATO-backed proxy is widening the war.
stories.what_it_means: A NATO-backed proxy is widening the war.
stories.economic_impact: Fuel and food have to go the long way.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a backed crew blowing up the other side's bridge.
